evidence.title: Global Semiconductor Equipment Billings Increased 23% Year-Over-Year in Q2 2026, SEMI Reports
evidence.summary: SEMI reported Q2 2026 global semiconductor equipment billings of US$40.53 billion, up 23% year over year and 11% quarter over quarter, marking a second consecutive record quarter as AI infrastructure investment sustained advanced-manufacturing capacity demand.

evidence.title: 2026 Mid-Year Total Semiconductor Equipment Forecast
evidence.summary: SEMI's 2026 mid-year forecast projects total semiconductor manufacturing equipment sales of US$165.9 billion in 2026, up 23.2%, with WFE at US$143.9 billion, up 23.1%, driven by leading-edge logic, advanced memory, test and packaging investment for AI workloads.

evidence.title: 公告：辛耘 2026年8月合併營收10.68億元 年增18.06%
evidence.summary: 辛耘2026年8月合併營收10.68346億元、年增18.06%，1-8月累計81.56998億元、年增8.12%；近期公司說法並顯示自製設備產能滿載、2026出貨量估增約五成，部分客戶已預訂2028年產能。

evidence.title: 公告：志聖 2026年8月合併營收8.66億元 年增60.73%
evidence.summary: 志聖2026年8月合併營收8.65806億元、年增60.73%，1-8月累計70.77366億元、年增83.37%；公告指出成長原因為客戶需求提升。

evidence.title: 公告：帆宣 2026年8月合併營收72.2億元 年增83.89%
evidence.summary: 帆宣2026年8月合併營收72.19605億元、年增83.89%，1-8月累計502.46297億元、年增51.72%，顯示工程與設備整合認列仍強。

evidence.title: 半導體業最強擴產潮來了 廠務工程五強訂單塞爆
evidence.summary: 報導彙整半導體廠務工程五強在手訂單合計逾8,800億元，其中亞翔約4,400.73億元、漢唐約1,939億元、帆宣約1,351億元、洋基工程約517億元，並連結台積電全球近20座廠建置與後續擴產需求。

evidence.title: 2026年每月營收報告
evidence.summary: 亞翔官方月營收頁面目前列示2026年1月至7月，8月欄位尚未提供數值；這只能作為資料發布狀態紀錄，不能解讀為工程需求轉弱或延遲。

evidence.title: TSMC fab equipment demand nearly doubles in six months - AI surge pushes 2026 CapEx toward $64B amid tool shortages
evidence.summary: SEMICON Taiwan reporting says TSMC equipment demand rose to roughly 1.9 times its end-2025 estimate within six months, while global fab construction and tool availability remained capacity constraints.
